newsitem.title: USA: Fleming says Randalls wants out of pact.
newsitem.headline: Fleming says Randalls wants out of pact.

text.p: Fleming Cos Inc said Thursday that one of its customers, Randalls Food Markets Inc, is seeking to sever its contract with Fleming and is asking for damages, alleging that Fleming overcharged it, undercharged it and changed its "overall pricing formula."
In 1996, Randalls purchased approximately $484 million of product from Fleming, a food distributor, and has a contract with Fleming that extends through August 2001.
Fleming said that the dispute will be submitted to binding arbitration, which, by contract, prohibits punitive or consequential damages.
Fleming added that it believes the Randall claim is unwarranted and that it has complied with its contractual obligations. It said it intends to vigorously defend the action.
Representatives from Randall were not immediately available for comment.
